status: exploratory extension after binary benchmark; uncertainty block rule corrected after initial development run; not preregistered
state_encoding: 2 * B(year-1) + B(year); B = registered state-based deaths >= 25
scoring: unscaled categorical Brier (0..2); nominal states, no RPS; log loss clip 1e-12
selection: Report every model at every horizon on identical complete sequences. No selection or ensemble on test.
time_convention: Issue Jan 1 of year o; source information through o-2. Horizon H ends at o+H-1. Integrate over the unobserved bridge year o-1.
uncertainty: Paired circular blocks of origin years, length max(2,H), conditional on fitted models; no interval with fewer than two full blocks. Long-horizon overlap and few origins limit inference. Explorer bands are conditional Beta model intervals, not empirical coverage.
